overview.purpose_zh: 用同心圆环表达两层构成：内圈是 Fossil、Renewable、Nuclear 三个大类，外圈是每个大类下面的具体能源。
works_zh: 适合展示两层层级：大类套小类
适合看每一层内部的相对大小
uses_zh: 能源结构的两层拆分说明
任何“总计里再分类”的构成汇报

understanding.read_zh: 先看内圈三段的角度，确定三个大类的比例；再看外圈每个大类被切成哪些小段。角度比长度难比较，差距小时要读标签。

elements.note_zh: 三个大类各占一段，三段合起来是发电总量的全部。
把每个大类拆成具体能源，外圈的每一段归属内圈的同一块。
每一段的角度对应份额，角度越大份额越大，但小差距不容易看出来。
标签给出能源名称和份额，外圈太窄的段可能不显示文字。

observations.en: The inner ring splits generation into Fossil at 51%, Renewable at 35% and Nuclear at 14%.
observations.zh: 内圈把发电量分成三块：化石能源 51%、可再生能源 35%、核能 14%。

observations.en: In the outer ring, Coal is the largest source at 26%, just over half of the 51% Fossil ring.
observations.zh: 在外圈，煤炭是最大的能源，占 26%，略高于化石能源内圈的 51% 的一半。

observations.en: Hydro (15%) is the largest renewable source, ahead of Wind (12%) and Solar (8%).
observations.zh: 水电（15%）是最大的可再生能源，领先风电（12%）和太阳能（8%）。

observations.en: Oil is a thin outer sliver at 3%, the smallest source in the chart.
observations.zh: 石油是外圈很细的一条，只占 3%，是图上最小的能源。

observations.en: The three Fossil arcs take 51%, more than the Renewable and Nuclear rings combined.
observations.zh: 化石能源的三段合计 51%，超过可再生能源和核能两部分之和。

describe.en: The sunburst shows how total generation divides first by group and then by source.
describe.zh: 这张旭日图展示总发电量如何先按大类、再按具体能源逐层划分。
alternatives: The chart shows the generation mix at two levels.
It divides generation into groups and then into sources.
describe.note_zh: 两层结构要先说清楚，否则读者不知道内外圈各代表什么。

describe.en: Fossil fuels constitute 51% of generation, with Coal and Gas filling most of that ring.
describe.zh: 化石能源占发电量的 51%，其中煤炭和天然气填满了这一环的大部分。
alternatives: Fossil fuels make up 51% of the total.
The Fossil group accounts for just over half of generation.
describe.note_zh: constitute 比 make up 正式，适合书面描述；口语里 make up 更自然。

describe.en: Renewables make up 35% of generation across Hydro, Wind and Solar.
describe.zh: 可再生能源占发电量的 35%，来自水电、风电和太阳能。
describe.pattern: X makes up + percentage + of + whole
alternatives: Renewables account for 35% of the total.
Hydro, Wind and Solar together make up 35%.
describe.note_zh: make up 的主语是拆分出来的部分，不是整体。

describe.en: Coal leads the outer ring at 26%, closely followed by Gas at 22%.
describe.zh: 煤炭以 26% 领跑外圈，天然气以 22% 紧随其后。
describe.pattern: A + lead + closely followed by + B
alternatives: Coal is the largest source, followed closely by Gas.
Gas is a close second at 22%.
describe.note_zh: closely followed by 表示差距不大，这里两个数字只差 4 个百分点。

describe.en: Coal's share is more than three times as high as Solar's, at 26% against 8%.
describe.zh: 煤炭的份额是太阳能的三倍多，分别为 26% 和 8%。
describe.pattern: A is + three times as high as + B
alternatives: Coal is more than three times the size of Solar.
describe.note_zh: 倍数说法要先确认两个数确实成倍数关系，26% 和 8% 是三倍多。

describe.en: The data indicates that fossil sources still supply just over half of generation, at 51%.
describe.zh: 数据表明，化石能源仍供应一半以上的发电量，达到 51%。
alternatives: The figures show that fossil fuels remain dominant at 51%.
Just over half of generation still comes from fossil sources.
describe.note_zh: data indicates that 后面接完整从句，用来给结论而不是描述单个数字。

describe.zh: 核能的 14% 接近太阳能 8% 的两倍。
alternatives: Nuclear is almost twice the size of Solar.
At 14%, Nuclear is nearly double the 8% from Solar.
describe.note_zh: nearly 表示接近但没到，14% 对 8% 可以说 nearly double。

academic.en: The sunburst presents the generation total at two levels: the inner ring divides 100% among Fossil, Renewable and Nuclear, and the outer ring breaks each group into individual sources. Fossil is the largest inner segment at 51%, followed by Renewable at 35% and Nuclear at 14%. In the outer ring, Coal reaches 26% and Gas 22%, while Oil contributes only 3%. The renewable sector is led by Hydro at 15%, then Wind at 12% and Solar at 8%. Nuclear appears as a single outer segment of 14%. Because the rings are read by angle rather than a shared baseline, the group split is more legible than small differences between individual sources.
academic.zh: 这张旭日图分两层展示发电总量：内环把 100% 分给化石能源、可再生能源和核能，外环再把每组拆成具体来源。化石能源是最大的内环部分，占 51%，其次是可再生能源 35% 和核能 14%。外环中煤炭占 26%，天然气占 22%，石油仅占 3%。可再生能源以水电 15% 为首，其次是风电 12% 和太阳能 8%。核能是外环中单独的一段，占 14%。由于各环按角度而非共同基线读取，组间划分比单个来源之间的细微差别更容易看清。

business.en: Fossil fuels still hold 51% of generation, so our case for new renewable capacity starts in a market where Coal at 26% and Gas at 22% dominate the outer ring. Renewables sit at 35%, led by Hydro at 15%, with Wind at 12% and Solar at 8%. Nuclear is a single 14% slice. The hierarchy gives us the story in one view: our inner ring shows the three-way split, and the outer ring shows which source carries each group. We should treat Hydro and Wind as the established renewable base and give Solar, still the smallest of the three at 8%, a closer look.
business.zh: 化石能源仍占发电量的 51%，因此我们要新增可再生能源装机，面对的是一个由煤炭 26% 和天然气 22% 主导外环的市场。可再生能源占 35%，以水电 15% 为首，风电 12%，太阳能 8%。核能是单独的一块，占 14%。这个层级结构让我们一眼看清全局：内环显示三方划分，外环显示每组由哪些来源构成。做规划时，我们应把水电和风电视为已有的可再生能源基础，并重点关注三者中仍最小的太阳能，占 8%。

simple.en: This chart is a set of rings. The inner ring shows three groups. Fossil is 51%, Renewable is 35% and Nuclear is 14%. The outer ring shows what is inside each group. In Fossil, Coal is 26% and Gas is 22%, with Oil at 3%. In Renewable, Hydro is 15%, Wind is 12% and Solar is 8%. Nuclear is one source at 14%. Angles are hard to judge, so look at the labels.
simple.zh: 这张图是一组圆环。内环显示三个组：化石能源 51%，可再生能源 35%，核能 14%。外环显示每组里面的来源。化石能源里煤炭 26%，天然气 22%，石油 3%。可再生能源里水电 15%，风电 12%，太阳能 8%。核能是单独一种来源，占 14%。角度不好判断，所以请看标签。

language_notes.body_zh: 内圈是大类合计，外圈是小类拆分。说总数时用内圈，说构成时用外圈；同一个大类在内圈和外圈各出现一次，不要重复相加。
examples: The inner ring shows Fossil at 51%.
The outer ring splits Fossil into Coal, Gas and Oil.

language_notes.body_zh: 圆环用角度编码，眼睛比较角度不如比较长度准。差距小的两段不要凭感觉判断，直接读数字。
examples: Wind is 12% and Solar is 8%, a gap of 4 percentage points that is hard to see as an angle.
The labels give the exact share of each source.

language_notes.body_zh: Nuclear 这个大类只有一个能源，所以内圈和外圈都是 14%。遇到这种单成员大类，两层数值相同，不要以为是重复计算。
examples: Nuclear shows 14% in both rings because it has a single source.
